## Install and load packages

```{r}
## install.packages(c("rlang", "sf", "terra", "ggspatial", "prettymapr", "FedData", "tmap", "tidyverse", "units"), repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org") ##
library(ggspatial)
library(sf)    
library(terra)
library(tidyverse)
library(prettymapr)
library(FedData)
library(tmap)
library(rlang)
library(units)
```

## Import data (use your own file paths)

```{r}
##Import NLCD landcover data 
nlcd <- rast("C:/Users/andre/Documents/Documents/Data Freelance/Chicken_Turtles/FGCU_landcover.tiff")
nlcd_2010 <- rast("C:/Users/andre/Documents/Documents/Data Freelance/Chicken_Turtles/FGCU_landcover2010.tif")
nlcd_2011 <- rast("C:/Users/andre/Documents/Documents/Data Freelance/Chicken_Turtles/FGCU_landcover2011.tif")

##Import turtles Observations
Chicken_Turtles <- read.csv("C:/Users/andre/Documents/Documents/Data Freelance/Chicken_Turtles/Chicken_Turtles.csv")

```

## Transform data into shapefiles and match coordinate systems

```{r}
# Coordinate systems checks
crs(nlcd)
crs(nlcd_2010)
crs(nlcd_2011)
# transforma data
turtles_sf   <- st_as_sf(Chicken_Turtles, coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326)
turtles_proj <- st_transform(turtles_sf, crs = crs(nlcd))
```

## Clean up dates

```{r}
# Dates and years

table(turtles_proj$Year)
turtles_proj$date_clean <- dmy(turtles_proj$date)
turtles_proj$Year <- as.factor(turtles_proj$Year)

```

## Cropping rasters and observations to the same area

```{r}
# 5 km buffer, used to crop rasters and roads
turtles_buff <- st_buffer(turtles_proj, dist = 5000)

# crop obersvations with rasters
nlcd_crop <- crop(nlcd, vect(turtles_buff))
nlcd_crop_2010 <- crop(nlcd_2010, vect(turtles_buff))
nlcd_crop_2011 <- crop(nlcd_2011, vect(turtles_buff))
```

## Roads

```{r}
## Checking the coordinate system of the road shapefile using a query since they're massive. Use your own file path
st_crs(st_read("C:/Users/andre/Documents/Documents/Data Freelance/Chicken_Turtles/Florida_roads/Trans_RoadSegment_0.shp", quiet = TRUE, query = "SELECT * FROM Trans_RoadSegment_0 LIMIT 1"))

## Match coordinate systems and create a polygon around the roads we want
bbox_wkt <- st_as_text(st_as_sfc(st_bbox(st_transform(turtles_buff, crs = "NAD83"))))

## testing the filter. Should return only road segments within the polygon
roads_test <- st_read("C:/Users/andre/Documents/Documents/Data Freelance/Chicken_Turtles/Florida_roads/Trans_RoadSegment_0.shp", wkt_filter = bbox_wkt, quiet = TRUE)
nrow(roads_test)  

## Pull out only road shapefiles from the dataset
segments <- list.files("C:/Users/andre/Documents/Documents/Data Freelance/Chicken_Turtles/Florida_roads", pattern = "Trans_RoadSegment.*\\.shp$", full.names = TRUE)

## Figuring out which shape files have roads within our buffer. This code might take a second to run
results <- lapply(segments, function(f) {
  r <- tryCatch(st_read(f, wkt_filter = bbox_wkt), error = function(e) NULL)
  nrow(r)
})
names(results) <- basename(segments)
results

## putting those roads into one list and making sure all coordinate systems match
roads_list <- lapply(segments, function(f) {
  st_read(f, wkt_filter = bbox_wkt)
})

roads_fl <- do.call(rbind, roads_list)
roads_proj <- st_transform(roads_fl, crs = crs(nlcd_crop))

```

### Crop, classify, and split by road type

```{r}

tnmfrc_labels <- c(
  "1" = "Interstate/Highway",
  "4" = "Local Road"
)

roads_final <- st_crop(roads_proj, ext(nlcd_crop))
roads_final$road_type <- tnmfrc_labels[as.character(roads_final$tnmfrc)]
roads_final <- roads_final[!is.na(roads_final$road_type), ]

roads_highway <- roads_final[roads_final$road_type == "Interstate/Highway", ]
roads_local   <- roads_final[roads_final$road_type == "Local Road", ]
```

## Add habitat labels

```{r}
nlcd_labels <- data.frame(
  value = c(11, 21, 22, 23, 24, 90, 95),
  label = c("Open Water", "Developed, Open Space", "Developed, Low Intensity",
            "Developed, Medium Intensity", "Developed, High Intensity", "Woody Wetlands", "Emergent Herbaceous Wetlands")
)
## Define custom color pallette
nlcd_palette_present <- c(
  "Open Water"                   = "#4682B4",
  "Developed, Open Space"        = "#E0D6C3",
  "Developed, Low Intensity"     = "#C5B5A1",
  "Developed, Medium Intensity"  = "#9E8E81",
  "Developed, High Intensity"    = "#6E6058",
  "Woody Wetlands"               = "#5A8F7B",
  "Emergent Herbaceous Wetlands" = "#7FA09B"
)
levels(nlcd_crop)      <- nlcd_labels
levels(nlcd_crop_2010) <- nlcd_labels
levels(nlcd_crop_2011) <- nlcd_labels
```

## Maps

### Define the map extent

```{r}
zoom_bbox <- st_bbox(st_buffer(turtles_proj, dist = 250))
```

### Map draft

```{r}
tm_shape(nlcd_crop, bbox = zoom_bbox) +
  tm_raster(style = "cat", palette = nlcd_palette_present, title = "Habitat Type") +
tm_shape(roads_local) +
  tm_lines(col = "gray30", lwd = 0.6) +
tm_shape(roads_highway) +
  tm_lines(col = "black", lwd = 2.5) +
tm_shape(turtles_proj) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.4, col = "black") +
tm_layout(
  frame = TRUE,
  legend.outside = TRUE,
  legend.outside.position = "right",
  legend.title.size = 1.1,
  legend.text.size = 0.8
) +
tm_compass(position = c("right", "top"), size = 1.5) +
tm_scalebar(position = c("left", "bottom"))
```

### Precise Map

```{r}

Turtles_precise <- tm_shape(nlcd_crop, bbox = zoom_bbox) +
  tm_raster(
    style = "cat",
    palette = nlcd_palette_present,
    title = "Habitat Type",
    drop.levels = TRUE 
  ) +
  tm_graticules(
    lines = TRUE,
    labels.size = 0.6,
    n.x = 7,
    col = "gray70",
    lwd = 0.3
  ) +
  tm_shape(roads_local) +
  tm_lines(
    col = "gray30",
    lwd = 2
  ) +
  tm_shape(turtles_proj) +
  tm_symbols(
    size = 1,
    lwd = 2,
    fill = "Year",
    shape = "Accuracy",
    fill.scale = tm_scale_categorical(values = "area7d"),
    shape.scale = tm_scale_categorical(values = c("Approximate" = 22, "Exact" = 21)),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Year Observed"),
    shape.legend = tm_legend_hide(),
    col = "black"
  ) +
  tm_layout(
    main.title = "Chicken Turtle Observations",
    main.title.size = 1.2,
    main.title.position = "center",
    frame = TRUE,
    legend.outside = TRUE,
    legend.outside.position = "right",
    legend.title.size = 1.1,
    legend.text.size = 0.8
  ) +
  tm_compass(
    position = c("right", "top"),
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  tm_scalebar(
    position = c("left", "bottom")
  ) +
  tm_add_legend(
  type = "symbols",
  title = "Location precision",
  labels = c("Approximate", "Exact"),
  shape = c(22, 21),
  fill = c("gray90", "gray40"),
  col = "black"
) 

Turtles_precise
```

### Buffered Map

```{r}
## Define buffer size 
turtles_buffered <- st_buffer(turtles_proj, dist = 100)

## Create map
Turtles_buffered <- tm_shape(nlcd_crop, bbox = zoom_bbox) +
  tm_raster(style = "cat", palette = nlcd_palette_present, title = "Habitat Type") +
  tm_graticules(
    lines = TRUE,
    labels.size = 0.6,

    n.x = 7,
    lwd = 0.3

  tm_polygons(
    fill = "Year",

    fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Year Observed"),
    fill_alpha = 0.7,
    col = "black",
    lwd = 0.5
  ) +
tm_layout(
  main.title = "Chicken Turtle Observations",
  main.title.size = 1.2,
  main.title.position = "center",
  frame = TRUE,
  legend.outside = TRUE,
  legend.outside.position = "right",
  legend.title.size = 1.1,
  legend.text.size = 0.8
) +
tm_compass(position = c("right", "top"), size = 1.5) +
tm_scalebar(position = c("left", "bottom"))

Turtles_buffered
```

## Timeline of observations

```{r}

Turtles_timeline <- ggplot(turtles_proj, aes(x = as.numeric(as.character(Year)))) +
  geom_dotplot(
    binwidth = 1,
    binaxis = "x",
    dotsize = 0.5,
    fill = "darkgreen",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(min(as.numeric(as.character(turtles_proj$Year)), na.rm = TRUE),
                 max(as.numeric(as.character(turtles_proj$Year)), na.rm = TRUE), 
                 by = 1)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Chicken Turtle Observations by Year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Count"
  )

Turtles_timeline
```

## Habitat composition: 2010 vs. 2025

### Align the rasters

```{r}

zoom_ext <- ext(zoom_bbox["xmin"], zoom_bbox["xmax"], zoom_bbox["ymin"], zoom_bbox["ymax"])

nlcd_2010_aligned <- crop(nlcd_2010, zoom_ext)
nlcd_2025_aligned <- crop(nlcd,      zoom_ext)

nlcd_mask_common  <- as.polygons(nlcd_2025_aligned > -Inf, dissolve = TRUE)
nlcd_2010_aligned <- mask(nlcd_2010_aligned, nlcd_mask_common)
nlcd_2025_aligned <- mask(nlcd_2025_aligned, nlcd_mask_common)

levels(nlcd_2010_aligned) <- nlcd_labels
levels(nlcd_2025_aligned) <- nlcd_labels
```

### Area by habitat type

```{r}

freq_2010 <- freq(nlcd_2010_aligned)
freq_2025 <- freq(nlcd_2025_aligned)

# Cell area in m^2 converted to hectares
cell_size <- res(nlcd_2010_aligned)[1] * res(nlcd_2010_aligned)[2]

freq_2010$area_ha <- freq_2010$count * cell_size / 10000
freq_2025$area_ha <- freq_2025$count * cell_size / 10000

freq_2010$year <- "2010"
freq_2025$year <- "2025"

habitat_compare <- rbind(
  freq_2010[, c("value", "area_ha", "year")],
  freq_2025[, c("value", "area_ha", "year")]
)

freq_2010
freq_2025
```

### Bar chart

```{r}

Habitat_comparison <- ggplot(habitat_compare, aes(x = value, y = area_ha, fill = year)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("2010" = "#66C2A5", "2025" = "#FC8D62")) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Habitat Composition, 2010 vs. 2025",
    x = "Habitat Type",
    y = "Area (hectares)",
    fill = "Year"
  )

Habitat_comparison
```

## Observation extent by year

### Summary table

```{r}
## For each year, count the observations, find the first and last dates, and calculate the area of the bounding box around the points in hectares.
extent_by_year <- turtles_proj %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    d <- .x
    tibble(
      n_obs = nrow(d),
      date_min = if (all(is.na(d$date_clean))) as.Date(NA) else min(d$date_clean, na.rm = TRUE),
      date_max = if (all(is.na(d$date_clean))) as.Date(NA) else max(d$date_clean, na.rm = TRUE),
      bbox_area_ha = if (nrow(d) > 1) {as.numeric(set_units(st_area(st_as_sfc(st_bbox(d))), "ha"))} else
        {NA_real_})}) %>%
  ungroup()

## Format those results into a table 
extent_summary <- extent_by_year %>%
  transmute(
    Year,
    `Date Range` = if_else(
      is.na(date_min),
      "No date recorded",
      paste(format(date_min, "%b %d"), "–", format(date_max, "%b %d"))),
    `# Observations` = n_obs,
    `Bounding Box Area (ha)` = round(bbox_area_ha, 2))

extent_summary

```
